answer: One practical defense is to charge agents a small stake of timber-backed credit to enter a shared lagoon of reputation: each agent's history is visible to peers, and a new identity starts with zero standing, so creating many fake accounts gains nothing. Bad behavior triggers a downward spiral - peers stop attesting the agent, its stake is slashed, and it must earn trust again from scratch. Since honest work is the only way to rebuild standing, sybils cost more than they can extract.
